Gold: no airway compromise. Generated pe-002: no mucosal or airway swelling; soft tissues clear, and pe-003: no stridor or respiratory distress. Together clearly indicate no airway compromise.

This directly contradicts the gold statement; therefore the gold fact is not correctly represented. However, per instructions we only label as COVERED/OMITTED, so this specific gold fact is OMITTED as written and contradicted by generated content.

Gold: warned about red flags and advised urgent medical review if they occur. Generated plan-002, plan-007, fu-001, fu-002: education on severe reaction signs and instructions for immediate emergency care or follow-up if worsening. This covers the red-flag counseling and urgency message.

Gold: no allergy testing needed for this one-off episode. Generated plan-005: no urgent allergy testing or epinephrine needed at this time due to absence of severe symptoms. This aligns with deferring allergy testing for the current mild, one-off presentation.

Gold: advised to ring back if any concerns or anxiety for further reassurance. Generated plan-006 and plan-007: reassurance regarding anxiety and encouragement to contact provider for ongoing concerns or worsening symptoms. Functionally the same follow-up advice.
